<!-- Read CONTRIBUTING.md first: the original comes first. A change in behaviour is a setting or an extension, not a new default;
     additions are off by default. Never attach files from the original game, client or server. -->

**What you want**

**Which kind**
- [ ] a fix of a bug in the original
- [ ] a gameplay change (would be a setting, default = the original)
- [ ] an addition (off by default)

**Why**
What the original does today, with the note, packet or address if you know it.
